9 in 10 members ride in the U.S., clustered across the NY / NJ / CT tri-state — with 10,000+ in the metro area alone. The rest reach into 90+ countries, from Nigeria to the UK.

What actually moves the group

Safety is the glue

The posts that travel furthest are crash warnings and gear reminders — "wear your gear, make it home." A single safety PSA pulled 228 comments and 7,800+ views.

They ride, together

Weekend group rides run all season — Bear Mountain, Tail of the Dragon, Mystic, Woodstock — organized in the feed, split into fast, intermediate and beginner groups.

Rookies land here first

New riders introduce themselves constantly — first bike, fresh license, MSF course done — and get welcomed in. It's the on-ramp to NYC riding.

This is what the feed looks like in real life.

Bikes bar to bar, riders shoulder to shoulder — sportbikes, adventure bikes, cruisers and everything between, parked up on a Manhattan block.
